title: Everyone deserves their voice to be heard: Analyzing Predictive Gender Bias in ASR Models Applied to Dutch Speech Data

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) performance disparities between male and female speakers by analyzing Word Error Rate (WER), Character Error Rate (CER), and a BERT-based Semantic Similarity (BSS) metric, evaluated through statistical significance tests (t-tests, ANOVA) and a proposed WER Parity metric.
